text: Make the heading row A1:M1 Bold, give it Yellow fill colour and apply Wrap Text.
In column K (Total) find the Total of Hindi, English, Computer and Rajasthan GK (F to I) for every student using the SUM function.
In column L (Percentage) find the percentage of every student. Each subject is out of 100, so the maximum total is 400 (Percentage = Total ÷ 400).
In column M (Result) using IF function write "PASS" if the Total is 160 or more (>=160), otherwise write "FAIL".
In cell T2 find the total number of students using COUNTA on Student Name (B2:B201), and in cell T3 find how many students appeared in English using COUNT on G2:G201.
Select M2:M201 and with Conditional Formatting highlight the cells equal to "FAIL" with Light Red Fill with Dark Red Text.
Apply Filter to the complete table A1:M201.
Apply Percentage Number Format with 2 decimal places to the Percentage column L2:L201.
Apply All Borders to the complete table A1:M201.
Apply AutoFit Column Width to the columns A to M, and Center alignment to the Gender column C2:C201.
Freeze the Top Row of the sheet, and rename the sheet Sheet1 to "Students".
Give the heading row A1:M1 a Dark Blue font colour and Font Size 12, in addition to the Bold, Yellow fill and Wrap Text from question 1.
Apply Italic to the Category column E2:E201, and Center alignment to the Rajasthan GK column I2:I201.
Give the sheet tab a Blue Tab Color, and Bold the Total column K2:K201.
Apply Number Format with 0 decimal places (no digits after the decimal point) to the Typing Speed column J2:J201, and Center alignment to J2:J201.
